summary: Guarantees the Right to Life, which courts have interpreted to include the right to safe public infrastructure, clean water, and a hazard-free environment.
Empowers Executive Magistrates to issue orders to remove public nuisances, obstructions, or hazardous conditions on public ways.
Mandates that public streets are vested in the municipality and obligates them to keep streets in repair.
Vests all public streets, sewers, and drains in the corporation and mandates their regular repair and maintenance.
Vests the responsibility of construction, maintenance, and development of state highways in the Highways Authority.
Imposes liability and penalties on authorities/contractors for failure to comply with standards of road design, construction, and maintenance.
Imposes penalties for danger or obstruction in public way or line of navigation caused by negligence.
Mandates municipal councils to provide and maintain public sewers, drains, and latrines, ensuring proper sanitation.
Requires the corporation to arrange for the daily collection, removal, and disposal of solid waste and sewage.
Details the duties of local authorities for door-to-door collection, segregation, and scientific processing of solid waste.

actName: Employment of Manual Scavengers and their Rehabilitation Act, 2013
summary: Prohibits manual scavenging and obligates local authorities to use mechanized cleaning for sewers and septic tanks.
Provides penalties for failing to comply with rules regarding waste disposal and environmental pollution.

actName: Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974
summary: Prohibits the entry of polluting or toxic matter into streams, wells, or land, obligating water boards to maintain quality.

actName: Tamil Nadu Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, 1970
summary: Vests the TWAD Board with the duty of executing water supply and sewerage schemes across municipal and rural districts.

actName: Chennai Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Act, 1978
summary: Obligates the CMWSSB to provide a regular supply of wholesome water for domestic consumption in Chennai metropolitan area.
Obligates municipalities to secure a constant supply of safe drinking water for public and private use.
Requires distribution licensees to maintain electricity lines and infrastructure in a safe and hazardous-free manner.
Empowers the Central Electricity Authority to enforce regulations relating to safety and electric supply, preventing danger or accidents.

actName: Central Electricity Authority (Measures relating to Safety and Electric Supply) Regulations, 2010
summary: Prescribes detailed safety parameters and clearance distances for overhead power lines, cables, and transformers to prevent electrocution.
Empowers and obligates the municipal executive authority to remove any building, fence, or encroachment on public streets.
Obligates municipalities to maintain adequate street lighting in all public streets and places.
Lists duties of village panchayats including construction/maintenance of village roads, drains, and public toilets.

actName: Street Vendors (Protection of Livelihood and Regulation of Street Vending) Act, 2014
summary: Requires municipal corporations to regulate street vending zones without causing public obstruction on walking pathways.
